id: title:Gilbert09:retry transient proxy to backend connect failures

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery: PostgreSQL connection error handling allows PostHog warehouse ingestion to recover from transient backend unavailability caused by a TCP proxy, rather than treating it as a permanent connection failure.
review.reason: Adds a specific exception message and its corresponding test case to PostgreSQL connection error handling. This substantive, bounded improvement demonstrates a reliability enhancement for warehouse ingestion recovery.
review.uncertainty: The actual recovery behavior and its effectiveness are not demonstrated by the code implementation, only the addition of the exception and test. No unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception message and its corresponding test case to the PostgreSQL connection error handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog warehouse ingestion to recover from transient backend unavailability caused by a TCP proxy, rather than treating it as a permanent connection failure.
